extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners, patent attorneys, agents, and applicants (practitioners working with USPTO restriction and double-patenting practice)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance from the MPEP Chapter 0800 on restriction practice under 35 U.S.C. 111 and nonstatutory double patenting: definitions, when restriction is proper, how to determine distinctness/independence (genus/species, combinations/subcombinations, process/product relationships), election/reply rules, rejoinder, and related procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis for Restriction Practice in Statute and Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 802: The statutory and rule-based foundation for imposing restriction requirements under 35 U.S.C. 111 and applicable rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meaning of “Independent” and “Distinct”
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 802.01: The definitions and legal meaning of the terms 'independent' and 'distinct' as used in restriction practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of Restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 802.02: What constitutes a restriction requirement in a patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction — When Proper
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803: The circumstances under which an examiner may properly require restriction between claimed inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review by Examiner with At Least Partial Signatory Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.01: Requirement that restriction determinations be reviewed by an examiner with appropriate signatory authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election of Species Requirements – Markush Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.02: Special considerations for election of species when Markush type claims are presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitional Application — Linking Claim Allowable
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.03(a): Practice for transitional applications where a linking claim is allowable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitional Application — Generic Claim Allowable
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.03(b): Practice for transitional applications where a generic claim is allowable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nucleotide Sequences
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.04: Restriction practice guidance specific to claims involving nucleotide sequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissue Application Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 803.05: How restriction practice applies in the context of reissue applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804: The definition and scope of double patenting (statutory and nonstatutory) as applied by the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition of Nonstatutory Double Patenting Rejections Under 35 U.S.C. 121
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804.01: Rule that nonstatutory double patenting rejections are prohibited in certain circumstances under § 121.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoiding a Double Patenting Rejection
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804.02: Practices and measures to avoid a nonstatutory double patenting rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commonly Owned Inventions of Different Inventive Entities; JRAs
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804.03: Treatment of commonly owned inventions of different inventive entities and inventions subject to a Joint Research Agreement (JRA) with respect to double patenting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission to Technology Center Director
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804.04: Circumstances under which issues (e.g., double patenting or complex restriction questions) should be submitted to the Technology Center Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact of Patent Term Extension under 35 U.S.C. 156 on Nonstatutory Double Patenting
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 804.05: How patent term extensions affect analysis of nonstatutory double patenting issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of Improper Joinder in Patent
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 805: Consequences when claims improperly join distinct inventions in a single patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination of Distinctness or Independence of Claimed Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806: Overall framework for determining whether claimed inventions are distinct or independent for restriction purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare Claimed Subject Matter
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.01: The comparative analysis of claim scope/subject matter to determine distinctness or independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single Embodiment, Claims Defining Same Essential Features
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.03: Consideration that claims to a single embodiment or claims defining the same essential features may not be distinct inventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genus and/or Species Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04: Rules for analyzing genus (generic) claims versus species (specific) claims when considering restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Species May Be Independent or Related Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(b): Recognition that species of a genus may be either independent inventions or related inventions depending on patentable distinctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition of a Generic Claim
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(d): Definition and role of a generic (genus) claim in restriction analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Limited to Species
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(e): Treatment of claims that are limited to species in restriction practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction Between Mutually Exclusive Species
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(f): Guidance on imposing restriction when species are mutually exclusive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Species Must Be Patentably Distinct From Each Other
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(h): Requirement that species be patentably distinct from each other to avoid restriction or to be treated in particular ways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generic Claims Presented In a Separate Application After Issuance of Species Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.04(i): Practice addressing presentation of generic claims in a separate application following issuance of species claims in another application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related Inventions (Combination and Subcombination)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05 and 806.05(a): Analysis of related inventions, including combinations and subcombinations, when deciding distinctness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Criteria of Distinctness Between Combination and Subcombination
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(c): Specific criteria used to evaluate whether a combination and a subcombination are distinct inventions for restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcombinations Usable Together
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(d): Consideration that subcombinations which are usable together may affect distinctness analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process and Apparatus for Its Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(e): Relationship and distinctness considerations between a process and apparatus for practicing the process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process of Making and Product Made
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(f): Evaluation of distinctness between a process of making something and the product made by that process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apparatus and Product Made
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(g): Distinctness considerations between apparatus and the product made by the apparatus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product and Process of Using
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(h): Distinctness relationship between a product and a process of using that product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product, Process of Making, and Process of Using
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(i): Guidance when claims cover product, process of making the product, and process of using the product together.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related Products; Related Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.05(j): Consideration of related products and related processes in distinctness analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 806.06: Identification and treatment of inventions that are independent of one another for restriction practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability Report Practice Has No Effect on Restriction Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 807: Statement that patentability reports (e.g., patentability determinations) do not alter the Office's restriction practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for Insisting Upon Restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 808: The rationales and reasons an examiner may insist on restriction (e.g., clarity, search/examination efficiency, distinct inventions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reasons for Holding of Independence or Distinctness (Species)
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 808.01 and 808.01(a): Specific reasons or factual findings supporting a holding that claims are independent or distinct, including species-specific considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishing Burden
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 808.02: How the burden is established (and by whom) when asserting independence/distinctness for restriction purposes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Linking Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 809: Concept of linking claims that may connect otherwise distinct inventions and how linking claims affect restriction/election analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election of Species Required
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 809.02 and 809.02(a): Circumstances under which an election of species is required in response to a restriction requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction Between Linked Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 809.03: How restriction should be handled where inventions are linked by allowable claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action on the Merits
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 810: Guidance that restriction practice does not eliminate examination on the merits; examiner must act on allowable subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time for Making Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 811: Timing rules for when a restriction requirement must be made by the Office and related time limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Requirement After Compliance With Preceding Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 811.02: Circumstances in which the Office may make a new restriction requirement after the applicant has complied with a prior requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repeating After Withdrawal Proper
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 811.03: Situations in which repeating a restriction requirement after withdrawal of an earlier requirement is proper.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper Even Though Grouped Together in Parent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 811.04: Restriction requirements may be proper even if claims were grouped together in a parent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who Should Make the Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 812: Guidance as to which Office personnel should formulate and make restriction requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephone Restriction Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 812.01: Procedures and limitations for conducting restriction practice by telephone communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate Exactly How Application Is To Be Restricted
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 814: Requirement that the restriction statement should indicate precisely how the application is to be restricted (which claims/inventions are grouped).

rubrics_metrics.name: Make Requirement Complete
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 815: A restriction requirement must be complete, explaining the inventions and how the claims are partitioned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outline of Letter for Restriction Requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 817: Recommended outline/form for the Office's restriction requirement letter to the applicant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election and Reply — Election in Reply to a Restriction Requirement: Express
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818 and 818.01: Rules governing how an applicant must elect an invention in reply to a restriction requirement, including express elections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reply Must be Complete
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.01(a): Requirement that an applicant's reply to a restriction requirement be complete.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election is Required, Even When Requirement Is Traversed
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.01(b): Statement that an election is required even if the applicant traverses the restriction requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Traverse is Required To Preserve Right of Petition
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.01(c): To preserve the right to petition a restriction, the applicant must traverse the requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Traverse of Restriction Requirement With Linking Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.01(d): Considerations for traversing a restriction requirement when linking claims are present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election Other Than Express
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.02: Ways an election may be made other than by express statement (e.g., by cancellation of claims, by payment of fees, or by other actions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Election By Originally Presented Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.02(a): Electing by leaving originally presented claims intact or otherwise indicating election through original claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Generic Claims Only — No Election of Species; Linking Claims Only – No Election of Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.02(b): Special rules when only generic claims are presented or when only linking claims are present regarding whether an election is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election By Optional Cancelation of Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.02(c): Election effected by optionally canceling claims to select the elected invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Election By Cancelation of Claims, Lacking Express Election Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 818.02(d): Election may be implied by cancellation of claims even without an express election statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office Generally Does Not Permit Shift
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 819: The Office's general rule that applicants are not permitted to shift their election to a different invention after making an election.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of Claims Held To Be Drawn to Nonelected Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821: How claims determined to be directed to nonelected inventions are to be treated (including after election and traversal scenarios).

rubrics_metrics.name: After Election With Traverse
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.01: Treatment of nonelected claims following an election made with traversal of the restriction requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: After Election Without Traverse
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.02: Treatment of nonelected claims when an election is made without traversal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims for Different Invention Added After an Office Action
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.03: How to handle claims that are added after an Office action and are directed to a different invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejoinder
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.04: Conditions under which previously nonelected claims may be rejoindered (rejoined) to an allowed claim set and examined in the same application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejoinder Between Product Inventions; Rejoinder Between Process Inventions
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.04(a): Rejoinder rules specific to product-to-product or process-to-process relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rejoinder of Process Requiring an Allowable Product
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 821.04(b): Rejoinder of process claims that may require an allowable product claim to be present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims to Inventions That Are Not Patentably Distinct in Plural Applications of Same Applicant or Assignee
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 822: Handling of claims across multiple applications by the same applicant/assignee when the inventions are not patentably distinct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention Under the Patent Cooperation Treaty
rubrics_metrics.description: MPEP section 823: How PCT unity of invention requirements relate to and inform U.S. restriction practice.
